executionRules: Authenticate all12 original providers, original archives/raw, committed v1 numerical/cost receipt, contract/recipes and frozen new sources before importing original mathematics.
Run cases1..12 once in listed order; each baseline is followed by its candidate. Stop on first mismatch/unknown/resource/source failure. No retry.

Each baseline and candidate receives its own fresh exact builtin Context constructed from the literal template and separate immutable Decimal fixture tuples. Select the actual Context with setcontext, do not copy it at call time; restore prior Context in finally.

Fixture construction is only exact Decimal(string), tuple and dict construction from these literals. No norm, quaternion, axis, support, projection or expectation formula is implemented. Both quaternionNorm literals are1 because listed quaternions are unit representations; no fixture trig or normalization is calculated.

Call original sat_pair once in each branch. A forwarding support delegate records actual original return/exception objects and flags without another arithmetic call. Candidate stage hits add no original support call.

Use stable recording forwarding callables across the whole control population, never a new delegate identity on each case. Key identity is the retained original SAT/support function and authenticated provider, not a per-case recorder. Counters can be detached snapshots without replacing those callables.
Snapshot and compare COMPLETE reply with Decimal.as_tuple/type and native scalar bits where present; never float-convert Decimal, project through Node or use Decimal numeric equality alone.
Track helper/SAT totals outside resettable cache counters. Per-case predicted counts are checked against actual calls and are not receipts until execution.

Main cache persists through cases1..9 except case8 clear-before. Case9 failure discards pending state. Capacity cache is new at case10, persists through12, and clears after12. Separate cache objects may coexist but retain only declared bounded entries.

After case9 pending-discard and prior-entry assertions, clear and release the main cache before creating capacity cache at10. Keep external actual totals. Aggregate live private cache/pending storage is bounded by67108864bytes, including an empty prior object if it is retained.

Snapshot all fixture tuples/Decimal representations before and after; verify settings/traps unchanged and actual postflags match baseline. Mutate only a detached report copy to check no cached mutable report alias.
Restore both SAT module pointers and all scope/context state in finally. No full evaluate/QP/World/fixture function is allowed in controls.
